name: Brent crude (spot)
description: The physical spot price of Brent crude, free on board, in US dollars per barrel, as published by the US Energy Information Administration. India imports most of its oil, so higher crude widens the trade deficit and weighs on the rupee. News reports usually quote Brent futures, which can be well below the spot price when physical supply is tight.
releaseSchedule: EIA publishes daily spot prices weekly, usually several days after the trading date. Updated automatically.
